enemies.name: Goblin Tracker
enemies.description: A goblin tracker wheels around, snarling at the ambush gone wrong!
enemies.successText: You drop the tracker before it can whistle for help!
enemies.failText: It nicks you with a jagged knife.

enemies.name: Goblin Tracker
enemies.description: A second tracker lunges from behind a tree!
enemies.successText: Parry and counter — down it goes!

enemies.name: Goblin Brute
enemies.description: A hulking brute blocks the trail deeper into the woods.
enemies.successText: A solid hit staggers the brute — it crumples!
enemies.failText: The brute's club catches you hard.
